basic.name: 普通攻击：狩月舞步
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的打击，造成物理伤害；
长按 【普通攻击键】 可以进行蓄力，提升招式的威力，并造成冰属性伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 strikes in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Hold down [Basic Attack] to charge up, increasing the power of the attack and dealing Ice DMG.

special.name: 特殊技：追猎时刻
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行连续打击，造成冰属性伤害；
长按 【特殊技键】 可以进行蓄力，提升招式的威力；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a series of strikes in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Hold down [Special Attack] to charge up, increasing its power.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：狂猎时刻
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行强力连续打击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
长按 【强化特殊技键】 可以进行蓄力，消耗能量并提升招式的威力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a series of powerful strikes in front, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Hold down [EX Special Attack] to charge up, consuming Energy and enhancing the power of the attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodge.name: 闪避：进退得体
dodge.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodge.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dashAttack.name: 冲刺攻击：保持清洁
dashAttack.trigger: 闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dashAttack.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
dashAttack.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方滑铲进行连续打击，造成物理伤害。
dashAttack.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Slides forward, launching a series of strikes in front, dealing Physical DMG.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：礼仪教导
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：遵命
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方小范围敌人发动强力连续打击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a series of powerful strikes at enemies in a small area in front of him, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：不辱使命
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力连续打击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes multiple powerful strikes at enemies in a large area, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：狼群
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动打击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：狩猎干预
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：复仇反扑
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
在前方生成冰柱并对区域内的敌人发动打击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Creates an icicle in front, which strikes all enemies within range, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.text: [围猎]状态有可用次数时，[支援突击：复仇反扑·冰舞]命中敌人时将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]，招式持续期间，队伍中其他角色通过[快速支援]入场时，莱卡恩会进入[围猎]状态，持续8秒。
fields.textEn: When Encircle Prey has available activations, hitting an enemy with Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad. During this skill, when other squad members enter via Quick Assist, Lycaon enters the Encircle Prey state for 8s.

fields.text:
莱卡恩在[普通攻击]中完成蓄力或发动[闪避反击]、[冲刺攻击]时，招式造成的失衡值提升80%；
[强化特殊技：狂猎时刻]、[支援突击：复仇反扑]或[支援突击：复仇反扑·冰舞]命中敌人时，目标的冰属性伤害抗性降低25%，受到的其他属性伤害提升30%，持续30秒。
进入战场时，莱卡恩会获得一次进入[围猎]状态的次数。
[围猎]状态有可用次数时，[支援突击：复仇反扑·冰舞]命中敌人时将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]，招式持续期间，队伍中其他角色通过[快速支援]入场时，莱卡恩会进入[围猎]状态，持续8秒。
当精英或首领级敌人进入失衡状态时获取一次进入[围猎]状态次数。[围猎]状态次数最多保存一次。
[围猎]状态结束时，莱卡恩会自动发动[支援突击：复仇反扑·冰舞]，若[围猎]状态提前结束，每剩余1秒时长便会使下一次[支援突击：复仇反扑·冰舞]造成的失衡值提升6%。
当前操作中角色停止进攻或发动[连携技]和[终结技]时，莱卡恩会提前结束[围猎]状态。
莱卡恩主动发动[支援突击：复仇反扑·冰舞]时，也会提前结束[围猎]状态，但不会自动发动[支援突击：复仇反扑·冰舞]。
[围猎]状态持续期间，莱卡恩会根据当前操作中角色发动的招式，分别相应发动[普通攻击]、[闪避]、[冲刺攻击]和[闪避反击]。
当操作中角色发动[普通攻击]或[强化特殊技]时，莱卡恩会同步发动[普通攻击]第一段至第三段；
当操作中角色发动[闪避]和[闪避反击]时，莱卡恩会同步发动[闪避]和[闪避反击]，处于[围猎]状态下发动[闪避反击]后，莱卡恩可直接衔接[普通攻击]第三段。
[围猎]状态持续期间，莱卡恩为非当前操作中代理人时发动的招式仅造成伤害与失衡值；莱卡恩为当前操作中角色时，[围猎]持续时间不再减少。
fields.textEn:
When Lycaon completes charging during a Basic Attack, or activates a Dodge Counter or Dash Attack, the Daze inflicted by the skill increases by 80%.
When EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt, Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack, or Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz hits an enemy, the target's Ice RES is reduced by 25%, and it increases the DMG to the target from other attributes by 30% for 30s.
Upon entering the battlefield, Lycaon gains one Encircle Prey activation chance.
When Encircle Prey has available activations, hitting an enemy with Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad. During this skill, when other squad members enter via Quick Assist, Lycaon enters the Encircle Prey state for 8s.
When an elite or boss enemy becomes Stunned, 1 Encircle Prey activation chance is gained. Up to 1 Encircle Prey activation can be stored.
When the Encircle Prey state ends, Lycaon automatically activates Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz. If the Encircle Prey state ends early, for every 1s of remaining duration, the Daze dealt by the next Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz increases by 6%.
When the currently active character stops attacking or uses a Chain Attack or Ultimate, Lycaon will end the Encircle Prey state early.
When Lycaon manually uses Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz, the Encircle Prey state also ends early, but Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz will not be automatically triggered.
While the Encircle Prey state is active, Lycaon will activate Basic Attack, Dodge, Dash Attack, and Dodge Counter based on the skills used by the currently active character.
When the currently active character uses a Basic Attack or EX Special Attack, Lycaon will simultaneously perform the 1st through 3rd hits of his Basic Attack.
When the active character performs a Dodge or Dodge Counter, Lycaon will simultaneously perform a Dodge or Dodge Counter. After performing a Dodge Counter while in the Encircle Prey state, Lycaon can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of his Basic Attack.
While the Encircle Prey state is active, when Lycaon is not the currently active Agent, his attacks only deal DMG and Daze. While Lycaon is the currently active character, the Encircle Prey duration does not decrease.

fields.text:
队伍中存在与自身属性或阵营相同的角色或其他[异常]角色时触发：
莱卡恩攻击命中处于失衡状态下的敌人时，目标的失衡易伤倍率提升35%。
fields.textEn:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same Attribute or Faction:
When Lycaon hits a Stunned enemy, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 35%.

fields.name: 核心被动：金属狼足
fields.trigger: 莱卡恩在[普通攻击]中完成蓄力或发动[闪避反击]、[冲刺攻击]时，招式造成的失衡值提升80%；
fields.triggerEn: When Lycaon completes charging during a Basic Attack, or activates a Dodge Counter or Dash Attack, the Daze inflicted by the skill increases by 80%.
fields.description:
莱卡恩在[普通攻击]中完成蓄力或发动[闪避反击]、[冲刺攻击]时，招式造成的失衡值提升80%；
[强化特殊技：狂猎时刻]、[支援突击：复仇反扑]或[支援突击：复仇反扑·冰舞]命中敌人时，目标的冰属性伤害抗性降低25%，受到的其他属性伤害提升30%，持续30秒。
进入战场时，莱卡恩会获得一次进入[围猎]状态的次数。
[围猎]状态有可用次数时，[支援突击：复仇反扑·冰舞]命中敌人时将触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]，招式持续期间，队伍中其他角色通过[快速支援]入场时，莱卡恩会进入[围猎]状态，持续8秒。
当精英或首领级敌人进入失衡状态时获取一次进入[围猎]状态次数。[围猎]状态次数最多保存一次。
[围猎]状态结束时，莱卡恩会自动发动[支援突击：复仇反扑·冰舞]，若[围猎]状态提前结束，每剩余1秒时长便会使下一次[支援突击：复仇反扑·冰舞]造成的失衡值提升6%。
当前操作中角色停止进攻或发动[连携技]和[终结技]时，莱卡恩会提前结束[围猎]状态。
莱卡恩主动发动[支援突击：复仇反扑·冰舞]时，也会提前结束[围猎]状态，但不会自动发动[支援突击：复仇反扑·冰舞]。
[围猎]状态持续期间，莱卡恩会根据当前操作中角色发动的招式，分别相应发动[普通攻击]、[闪避]、[冲刺攻击]和[闪避反击]。
当操作中角色发动[普通攻击]或[强化特殊技]时，莱卡恩会同步发动[普通攻击]第一段至第三段；
当操作中角色发动[闪避]和[闪避反击]时，莱卡恩会同步发动[闪避]和[闪避反击]，处于[围猎]状态下发动[闪避反击]后，莱卡恩可直接衔接[普通攻击]第三段。
[围猎]状态持续期间，莱卡恩为非当前操作中代理人时发动的招式仅造成伤害与失衡值；莱卡恩为当前操作中角色时，[围猎]持续时间不再减少。
fields.descriptionEn:
When Lycaon completes charging during a Basic Attack, or activates a Dodge Counter or Dash Attack, the Daze inflicted by the skill increases by 80%.
When EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt, Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack, or Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz hits an enemy, the target's Ice RES is reduced by 25%, and it increases the DMG to the target from other attributes by 30% for 30s.
Upon entering the battlefield, Lycaon gains one Encircle Prey activation chance.
When Encircle Prey has available activations, hitting an enemy with Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad. During this skill, when other squad members enter via Quick Assist, Lycaon enters the Encircle Prey state for 8s.
When an elite or boss enemy becomes Stunned, 1 Encircle Prey activation chance is gained. Up to 1 Encircle Prey activation can be stored.
When the Encircle Prey state ends, Lycaon automatically activates Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz. If the Encircle Prey state ends early, for every 1s of remaining duration, the Daze dealt by the next Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz increases by 6%.
When the currently active character stops attacking or uses a Chain Attack or Ultimate, Lycaon will end the Encircle Prey state early.
When Lycaon manually uses Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz, the Encircle Prey state also ends early, but Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz will not be automatically triggered.
While the Encircle Prey state is active, Lycaon will activate Basic Attack, Dodge, Dash Attack, and Dodge Counter based on the skills used by the currently active character.
When the currently active character uses a Basic Attack or EX Special Attack, Lycaon will simultaneously perform the 1st through 3rd hits of his Basic Attack.
When the active character performs a Dodge or Dodge Counter, Lycaon will simultaneously perform a Dodge or Dodge Counter. After performing a Dodge Counter while in the Encircle Prey state, Lycaon can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of his Basic Attack.
While the Encircle Prey state is active, when Lycaon is not the currently active Agent, his attacks only deal DMG and Daze. While Lycaon is the currently active character, the Encircle Prey duration does not decrease.
